Nous recherchons un profil créatif, polyvalent, réactif et autonome, capable d’intervenir sur différents besoins de communication visuelle, propositions clients, social media, vidéo et création assistée par IA. Missions principales Création de visuels pour Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, campagnes digitales et supports web. Création de posts, stories, carrousels, flyers, affiches, brochures et supports promotionnels. Création et mise en page de propositions commerciales, entertainment proposals, pitch decks et présentations clients . Création de moodboards, concepts visuels et directions artistiques pour événements, artistes, costumes, décors et activations. Création d’images et concepts avec des outils d’ intelligence artificielle . Montage de Reels, vidéos promotionnelles, contenus courts et event highlights . Motion graphics, animations, titres et transitions. Retouche photo, manipulation d’images, détourage et compositing. Création de branding, identités visuelles, templates et supports marketing. Adaptation des contenus aux différents formats et plateformes. Gestion des modifications et demandes créatives selon les besoins des projets. Organisation du travail Il ne s’agit pas d’un poste à temps plein avec des horaires fixes quotidiens . Le poste fonctionne comme un support créatif à distance et à la demande , en fonction des projets et besoins de Manoth Entertainment. Certaines journées peuvent comporter plusieurs demandes ou modifications, tandis que d’autres peuvent être beaucoup plus légères. Nous recherchons donc une personne : disponible et facilement joignable ; réactive lorsqu’une demande est transmise ; capable de respecter les délais convenus ; organisée pour gérer plusieurs petites missions simultanément ; à l’aise avec un fonctionnement flexible. Compétences recherchées Graphic Design Branding & Visual Identity Social Media Content Creation Video Editing & Reels Proposal & Presentation Design AI Creative Content Photo Editing & Compositing Motion Graphics Creative Direction Moodboard & Concept Development Outils appréciés Design: Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, Canva Pro, Figma, Adobe Express Vidéo: Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro Présentations: PowerPoint, Canva Presentations, Google Slides, Keynote IA créative: ChatGPT, Midjourney, Adobe Firefly, Leonardo AI, Ideogram, OpenAI Image Generation AI Video: Runway, Kling AI, Sora, Veo, Pika, HeyGen ou outils similaires Profil recherché Minimum 3 ans d’expérience en design graphique, création de contenu ou domaine similaire. Très bonne sensibilité visuelle. Bonne maîtrise de la typographie, composition, branding et storytelling visuel. Capacité à comprendre rapidement un brief. Autonomie et rapidité d’exécution. Capacité à travailler avec une équipe internationale. Anglais requis. Résidence à Marrakech fortement privilégiée . Expérience dans l’événementiel, entertainment, hôtellerie, luxe, nightlife, mode ou lifestyle appréciée. Rémunération 2 000 à 2 500 MAD / mois , selon le profil et l’expérience. La rémunération correspond au fonctionnement flexible, remote et à la demande du poste, et non à un emploi à temps plein avec 8 heures de travail quotidiennes. Portfolio obligatoire Merci d’envoyer des exemples de travaux incluant idéalement : Graphic Design Branding Social Media Reels / Vidéos Présentations / Propositions Moodboards AI Creative Content Pour postuler Envoyez votre CV + Portfolio à : hr@manothevents.com Objet : Application – Graphic Design & Creative Content Assistant Seuls les profils présélectionnés seront contactés pour la prochaine étape du processus de recrutement. Manoth Entertainment Dubai, UAE | Remote collaboration from Marrakech, Morocco

review_candidates.title: GDC Sourcing Officer -Junior Level
review_candidates.description: At Newmont, people create the value in the metals we mine and are ambassadors in the communities where they live and work. As a team, we foster an environment in support of our people vision, where everyone belongs, thrives and is valued. We have built a diverse and inclusive workplace where our people can bring their differences to support delivering results together. Newmont’s Service Enablement Group (SEG) is a new internal Newmont function that aims to improve processes and service delivery for the organization. It is comprised of two parts: A Process Excellence team and a future-state service delivery model who design will be informed by the work of the Process Excellence team. Join us and unearth your potential in a global company that is at the forefront of shaping the future of the mining industry. Your Impact As an Officer, Sourcing Services, you will play a key role in keeping Newmont’s global sourcing operations running smoothly. By maintaining accurate supplier data and supporting process improvements, you’ll help ensure we make informed, timely, and cost-effective supply chain decisions. As Part of Our Team, You Will Collect, maintain, and reconcile supplier data on cost, quality, delivery, and sustainability. Provide accurate performance information to meet sourcing service standards. Support process improvements and new tool implementations to streamline workflows. Assist in auditing and monitoring activities to resolve data quality issues. Collaborate with colleagues across teams to improve sourcing efficiency. Prerequisites for Your Success in This Role Education: Technical qualification or degree in Supply Chain, Finance, Engineering, or Business Administration. Experience: 1+ year in procurement, sourcing, or supply chain operations (shared services experience preferred). Technical Skills: Knowledge of ERP systems (SAP/Ariba preferred) and proficiency with Microsoft Office. Process Knowledge: Understanding of sourcing processes and supply chain fundamentals. High attention to detail and adherence to structured workflows. Strong communication, teamwork, and problem-solving skills. Your Work Environment You will be part of Newmont’s Global Delivery Center (GDC) in Costa Rica, working within the Corporate function. The role is people-focused and involves cross-functional collaboration with global stakeholders across People, Finance, IT, and Supply Chain teams. While the position is intended to be hybrid, as we establish our foundation, we will begin on-site to foster strong relationships, align our strategies, and ensure a solid framework for long-term success. This role is for the day shift schedule. Compensation will be aligned with the local Costa Rican market and paid in Costa Rican colones (CRC). Why Join Newmont Work with one of the world’s leading gold producers committed to safety, inclusion, and sustainability. Gain valuable experience in global procurement and process improvement. Competitive pay, benefits, and opportunities for growth and development. We understand no candidate will meet every single desired qualification. If your experience looks a little different from what we’ve identified and you think you can bring value to the role, we’d love to learn more about you! Our business success comes from the accomplishments and well-being of our employees and contractors. Our goal is to build a workplace culture that fosters leaders and allows every person to thrive, contribute, and grow. We are committed to selecting and developing our employees, and to establishing a work environment where everyone can take an active part in reaching our strategic goals while feeling a sense of pride in working at Newmont. Newmont seeks to recruit, hire, place and promote qualified applicants, meaning applicants who meet the minimum requirements of the position, without regard to personal characteristics such as gender, race, nationality, ethnic, social and indigenous origin, religion or belief, disability, age or sexual orientation or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

review_candidates.title: Electrical Engineer III (NASA/White Sands Test Facility)
review_candidates.description: About Us When you work at Chugach Government Solutions (CGS), you join a proud legacy of supporting missions while sustaining culture. The federal division of Chugach Alaska Corporation, CGS has been supporting critical missions as a government contractor for over 25 years. Our focus is to support facility maintenance, IT/technical services, construction and education. We are proud to have built, and continue to foster, an incredibly talented team spanning across the globe in hundreds of different fields – each team member proud to serve our country with first-class business services, while also making a difference for our Chugach shareholders. At CGS, empowering employees is a part of our core, and that focus is one of the ways we build and foster high-performing teams. We empower our employees through competitive compensation and benefits package, professional growth opportunities, truthful communication, and more! If you are looking for an opportunity to serve something bigger than yourself; if you want your day job to be one that creates meaningful value; if you are looking for an environment that highly values employees and respects individual differences – then Chugach Government Solutions may be the right fit for you! Position Location Position is located at the NASA/White Sands Test Facility in Las Cruces NM. Job Overview Provide electrical engineering support in the design, construction, & maintenance of any White Sands Test Facility (WSTF) requirements. Manages electrical design process and orchestrates the planning, design, cost estimating, procurement, and scheduling for projects. Provides recommendations for proposed engineering tests/products/equipment. Responsibilities Essential Job Duties: Works independently, or with minimal supervision relying heavily on prior professional experience and knowledge of state and local regulations. Supports electrical high voltage (>25KV), medium voltage (25KV-480V) to low voltage (480V-24V) AC power overhead distribution systems, emergency power systems, motor control, fire protection, lightning protection, arc flash, grounding, security systems, and fire alarm systems. Primary deliverables include scopes of work, speciﬁcations documents, and cost estimates for future projects. Utilizes professional knowledge of electrical, standard engineering theory and techniques, regulations to perform requirements determinations, technical assistance, and conventional design work. Supports electrical projects during construction including coordinating answers to Requests for Information, Change Orders, and solving problems that arise in the ﬁeld. Actively participates in design review committees and processes. Engages engineering support personnel for CADD and GIS support during project development. Serves as electrical engineer-of-record for design documents and reports. Prepares and presents informal and formal presentations to the customers and management. Supports and participates in the company safety program. Performs other related duties as assigned. Accountable For Knowledge of a broad range of electrical engineering design and construction standards, methods, practices, techniques, materials, and equipment to determine compliance with federal, state, and local codes and regulations. Ensures the highest standards are achieved and maintained in terms of safety, environmental performance, quality, and eﬃciency and makes recommendations for improvement when necessary. Keeping up-to-date and knowledgeable of applicable industry regulations and compliance requirements. Communicating eﬀectively, orally and in writing, including the ability to make presentations to senior team and client management. Effectively coordinating numerous projects simultaneously. Adherence to established company safety policies and good industrial and oﬃce safety practices. Compliance with company Standard Operating Procedures and Personnel policies and procedures. Ability to work well under pressure and deadlines. Proﬁciency in reading and interpreting engineering drawings, reports, and submittals. Provide occasional engineering support in the ﬁeld under all environmental conditions. Key Responsibilities: Manages electrical design process and orchestrates the planning, design, cost estimating, procurement, and scheduling for projects. Job Requirements Mandatory: Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering. Minimum of eight (8) years’ experience as a Design Engineer or Requirements Engineer in the field of electrical engineering. Skill in the use of MS Oﬃce products; Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint and Adobe Acrobat Standard/Pro at an intermediate level. Ability to pass pre-hire background and drug screening as required on the contract. Ability to obtain and maintain the required level clearance. U.S. Citizenship. Valid state driver’s license with acceptable driving record. Preferred Registered as a Professional Engineer in the state of New Mexico or the ability to receive reciprocity within the introductory period. Cross-discipline experience with mechanical and civil facility projects, building automation and control networks. Knowledge of the Energy Independence and Security Act of 2007 and its application with regard to electrical requirements for facilities and distribution systems. Basic knowledge of communications systems, as well as Instrumentation & Control (I&C) is needed. PLC and Logic are not required but preferred. Demonstrated skill in the use of AutoCAD, SKM Power Tool, EST3-SDU and Fireworks is a plus. Experience working on a government contract or on a government Working Conditions: Desk/office work and test area work. Test area work may involve standing and directing technical personnel. Field work may be necessary. Travel to remote sites/locations may be required. Walking on uneven terrain including paved areas, gravel/rocks, and dirt/sand is required to access various locations on the facility. All work must be completed in a safe manner in accordance with NASA and Company safety standards. Work hours are subject to change, with weekend and/or holiday work as needed. May be required to work outside normal duty hours. Physical Requirements: Work is performed primarily in an office setting. This job may involve walking, standing, bending, reaching, and handling of items weighing up to 30 pounds. Work requires the ability to operate a computer, effectively communicate information in verbal and written form, read and review information. Position is located on a hazardous testing facility; must be able to quickly evacuate buildings in the event of an emergency. May be required to wear breathing protection (respirator), hearing protection, eye protection and other associated personal protective equipment. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, pregnancy, disability, genetic factors, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. Chugach will provide reasonable accommodations, according to applicable state and federal laws, to all qualified individuals with physical or mental disabilities. In compliance with the ADA Amendments Act (ADAAA), if you have a disability and would like to request an accommodation in order to apply for a position with Chugach Government Solutions or any of its subsidiaries, please email ada@chugachgov.com. Chugach Government Solutions supports pay transparency and is committed to equitable and competitive compensation practices. Compensation for this role will be determined based on factors including job responsibilities, experience, skills, internal equity, geographic location, and applicable contract requirements.
